verdict.rationale: cubic documents API keys (personal or organization) for its Analytics and Members APIs, but nothing shows those keys can be scoped or limited to least-privilege permissions for an agent. The role-based access control it does document governs human team members' rights over subscription and settings, which is an adjacent feature, not scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
